items.title: Lew Tabackin interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999
items.q: The transcript only shows the interviewer introducing himself as Monk Rowe. The interviewee does not mention Monk Rowe in the provided context.

ctx.x: Lew was interviewed in New York City on January 17, 1999, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe. We are filming in Manhattan for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. It’s a very big pleasure for me to be speaking with Lew Tabackin today, jazz flautist and tenor saxophonist and band leader. Welcome.
